items.markdown:
A **supplement** is `something added to complete, enhance, or make up for a deficiency in something else` . Most commonly, it refers to a **dietary supplement** —a product taken by mouth (as a pill, capsule, powder, or liquid) to add nutrients or other substances to a person's diet.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXga8vDutgbHv4bjAc5xG-Y3TzTed9awwJSGVghIgtGlJ3lo-Jmp8GBm3qvndv0vQg-P0gTNnx--rJk-Pa5o41Wz6eTpcgJSpv6j1p7K476n0mc0b-eLz2u9CmnUvngRFm7FsIlh4sUIrZpCXo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXKQMpfhvZIa-Z13xb1QocHvvD7jnJi-BurA4QXJ7ddD_ZEyf0HwM_knHKhcd99hC8PlHZvF-rxM27y1DZapnMSICA64B6Ei56aIkaNSGnHTi2ORde8GnWlvCwOm22kDyX1cuuMePi4LvqhADDqmerKr_3ZCgJrCD_)

### General Meanings

- **Noun (general):** Something that adds to or completes a whole, such as an extra section in a book or newspaper, or an added fee.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXKQMpfhvZIa-Z13xb1QocHvvD7jnJi-BurA4QXJ7ddD_ZEyf0HwM_knHKhcd99hC8PlHZvF-rxM27y1DZapnMSICA64B6Ei56aIkaNSGnHTi2ORde8GnWlvCwOm22kDyX1cuuMePi4LvqhADDqmerKr_3ZCgJrCD_)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXga8vDutgbHv4bjAc5xG-Y3TzTed9awwJSGVghIgtGlJ3lo-Jmp8GBm3qvndv0vQg-P0gTNnx--rJk-Pa5o41Wz6eTpcgJSpv6j1p7K476n0mc0b-eLz2u9CmnUvngRFm7FsIlh4sUIrZpCXo)
- **Verb:** To add to something to improve it or make up a shortage, such as supplementing income or a diet.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXga8vDutgbHv4bjAc5xG-Y3TzTed9awwJSGVghIgtGlJ3lo-Jmp8GBm3qvndv0vQg-P0gTNnx--rJk-Pa5o41Wz6eTpcgJSpv6j1p7K476n0mc0b-eLz2u9CmnUvngRFm7FsIlh4sUIrZpCXo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXKQMpfhvZIa-Z13xb1QocHvvD7jnJi-BurA4QXJ7ddD_ZEyf0HwM_knHKhcd99hC8PlHZvF-rxM27y1DZapnMSICA64B6Ei56aIkaNSGnHTi2ORde8GnWlvCwOm22kDyX1cuuMePi4LvqhADDqmerKr_3ZCgJrCD_)

### Dietary Supplements Overview

- **Common types:** Vitamins, minerals, herbs/botanicals, amino acids, enzymes, probiotics, and protein powders.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX7X4FVQ4voXvezwtZxHCbftBHVLxD6iBFt45P2Np4hGScOBIYc80NSedSxx6LKB01oLNuNzd5GcWThKKSEiQc6G94pBkQ97lVkNYrOVIphyPXlQt7h7g7lEXjmAb57GpoUA8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1122gLmd_9_NGteT_N40hvOMdkwspIi8VxqtR7Lpqy9nc4RA2_mXQGh2ZS42UFK2vWkEOG3jf1lC1ct4w-W6XD7-QL1KF4YJRecBTvmWwl2pQn-HlSlufZZnt7h5-Yj5aJILIFLKX1JtomAy7Z_AItT07BkzLKE7WzsfdfWtNUqqQZRnTrGYypHOkb3VWHrifB5I)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GYJYPCJmspE&t=1)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yiaK0V4HE8M)
- **Popular examples:** Multivitamins, vitamin D, vitamin B12, iron, calcium, magnesium, omega-3 fish oil, and probiotics.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1122gLmd_9_NGteT_N40hvOMdkwspIi8VxqtR7Lpqy9nc4RA2_mXQGh2ZS42UFK2vWkEOG3jf1lC1ct4w-W6XD7-QL1KF4YJRecBTvmWwl2pQn-HlSlufZZnt7h5-Yj5aJILIFLKX1JtomAy7Z_AItT07BkzLKE7WzsfdfWtNUqqQZRnTrGYypHOkb3VWHrifB5I)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dEQGljAr2OY&t=7)
- **Purpose & limits:** They are meant to fill nutritional gaps—not replace whole foods or treat diseases—and work best when targeted to specific needs or deficiencies.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11vdnQ54gE0qAkdovMl9gFw1N84xlCnbR7ZhdBOfTvPjGyM4aLfg--1lt73C0lGFhFasG5xFa8lO1e6bvmyqhhBgjttHaGo1F2SXdAy8ahJDM6VQT3xfZMjVQLEuORUavLvIMq68OcBBdjNFWxCklahQfX2oVsd-DSBa0Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXKQMpfhvZIa-Z13xb1QocHvvD7jnJi-BurA4QXJ7ddD_ZEyf0HwM_knHKhcd99hC8PlHZvF-rxM27y1DZapnMSICA64B6Ei56aIkaNSGnHTi2ORde8GnWlvCwOm22kDyX1cuuMePi4LvqhADDqmerKr_3ZCgJrCD_)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rCPLgv9NOIc)

High doses or combinations can cause side effects or interact with medications.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dEQGljAr2OY&t=7)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GYJYPCJmspE&t=1)
